# Valuevade

> AI-personalised equity research and financial modelling course for Indian finance students and early-career switchers. One-time ₹1,500, lifetime access. Free first session, no card required.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://valuevade.com/): Overview of Valuevade, the Equity Research Analyst Program (21 modules · 239 sessions · 3 capstones), and how the AI tutor Pari, mock interviews and NISM/CFI prep fit together.
- [Courses](https://valuevade.com/courses): Catalog of Valuevade's finance career paths, starting with the Equity Research Analyst Program.
- [Equity Research Analyst Program](https://valuevade.com/course/5f69ef74-9bff-4cb7-9b5d-68a82d9aad5c): Full syllabus (module-by-module), learning outcomes, capstone deliverables, and enrolment details. ₹1,500 one-time lifetime access.
